summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal status questions from explicit complete-index evidence without retrieval or a model call.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email efficiency, accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
Current offline reproduction proved that one explicit complete-index status still fell through to retrieval and provider dispatch
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and project-question request authorize this deterministic completeness, accuracy and cost improvement.
known_limitations: Only strict English status/disposition forms naming one exact RFI or Submittal identifier use this path.
Questions asking for explanation, comparison, a yes/no predicate, another filter or an Email-thread status remain on the evidence/model path.
Only an explicit primary detected-or-manual status from the bounded vocabulary applicable to that workflow type is returned; missing, unknown or inapplicable status is not inferred.
Multiple statuses and a single malformed multi-state value remain insufficient evidence without chronology or authority inference.
Detected sources receive an inline quote only when existing immutable evidence ties the exact status phrase to the exact identifier; manual sources remain file-only.
